subject: W4 begun preview-first: #212 and #239 merged, §5.1 Preview opened as #240
result: MERGED: #212 (docs-only TUI human-experience spec, 33b852b) — the nine files on main citing docs/v2/23-TUI-HUMAN-EXPERIENCE-SPEC.md now resolve against a document the repo holds; three stale carried-unmerged-on-PR-212 doc comments dropped. #239 (49bff02) closed #230s open end: ProjectWorldReadModel gains credential_world (NOT an Option — absent input is CredentialWorldDisclosure::not_attempted, since a None would collapse the none-vs-could-not-tell distinction credential_world.rs exists to keep; serde(default) so pre-field readings load as an open question), with_credential_world mirroring with_versioned_world, and #[non_exhaustive] + ProjectWorldReadModel::empty(project, context) as the durable fix — note that #[non_exhaustive] ALONE would have broken the aikit-tui fixture rather than protecting it, since it forbids out-of-crate literals entirely; it needs the constructor to be usable. System pane now renders real credential/provider rows. OPENED #240: W4 first cut, preview-first per owner direction. New crates/aikit-tui/src/compose_preview.rs answers all nine of spec 5.1s Preview questions one row each in spec order, folded into the EXISTING Overlay::CompositionPreview beside the package-toggle summary (the same way Overlay::Explain folds explain_lines) — no new overlay, no second preview route, no new owner or ontology. Rows refuse four conflations the read model already keeps apart: authored vs merely-resolved, Unresolved vs Unavailable (only the determined no is withheld), requested-but-unresolved actor vs not-requested, absent versioned provider vs clean tree. Working environment and reprojection have no application-boundary answer and get an explicit not-exposed row rather than being dropped. Test split matters: the overlay pane is narrow and Wrap reflows prose, so the surface test drives the real Ctrl+Space->Ctrl+S route and asserts row labels while eight unit tests pin exact content. HAZARD RECORDED: another live session holds ~500 uncommitted lines in crates/aikit-core/src/knowledge_ingest.rs in the MAIN checkout; its test-compile errors briefly read as main being broken and are not. Both slices were built in their own worktrees (.worktrees/credential-world, .worktrees/compose-preview) with a separate CARGO_TARGET_DIR. Also: aikit-cli mux_install::the_installed_alt_a_opens_the_real_surface_and_ctrl_t_switches_modes fails locally on clean main — live-tmux attach timeout, environmental; CI passes it. NEXT: the W4 spine fields (Intention, Identity, Governance, Praxis, Information, Worlds/bounds, Runtime, Workspace/continuity), each now landing against a Preview that shows what it resolved to.
